params.message:
Source pages: a remark in the date field no longer stops the sync

No source page existed on the site. One report's source list gave a
remark as its date, longer than the column; the insert failed and the
whole sync of cited sources rolled back, on every run. The sync now
keeps the date that is in the field (a year, a month or a day) or none,
and clips a publisher name to the column.

Portal: De bronpagina's op gentells.com bestonden niet door een fout in het overnemen van één datum. Dat is opgelost; de links in de rapporten komen nu op een pagina uit.
